analyst_view.overall: Early view: LASK are 16th on six points after back-to-back wins, the latest 4-0 over Slovan Bratislava, and Fenerbahçe are 19th on five after beating Liverpool 3-2 under interim manager Dirk Kuyt. Fenerbahçe were without Marco Asensio (knee) and Jayden Oosterwolde (hamstring); whether Kuyt is still in charge by December is worth checking. I found little recent LASK team news.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean slightly higher: Fenerbahçe have conceded 11 in four league-phase games and LASK 9, and both attacks scored three or more in their last European games.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. I see no reason to move it: the teams are close in quality, and neither has a clear plan of camping in the other's half.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. I leave it: with the play-off places at stake for both, the game should be competitive, but I have nothing on the referee or recent bookings to move it.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots. I lean slightly lower: 30 is a lot for two mid-table sides, and Fenerbahçe, with Kanté and Guendouzi in midfield, may be happy to slow the game down away from home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.9 shots on target. I keep it: both teams finish well, and both defences are porous.
